title: Keto Naan Delight
description: A delicious keto twist on traditional naan bread, served with a delightful topping.
instructions: Roll out the naan dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Place the naan on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix the cheese, delight, garlic, salt, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the naan, leaving a 1/2 inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
Drizzle the heavy cream over the cheese mixture.
Dot the top of the naan with butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
